cand.title: Inaugurated Mexico headquarters in Puerta de Hierro, Zapopan; planned growth from 50 employees to 300+ by end-2027 and relocation of senior engineering leadership.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: No verified hotel buyer. Aribijay Bhaumik, Senior Director, Engineering at Ness Digital Engineering Mexico and LatAm in Guadalajara, is a plausible local business sponsor/referral contact. Tanaya Misra, Global Head – PR & Communications and named media contact for the expansion announcement, is an alternative introduction intermediary. Their hotel contracting authority is unverified.
findings.futureEdition: No future edition, dated meeting or accommodation programme was verified for November 2026–May 2028. The October 6, 2025 release announces an inauguration; it does not separately establish the ceremony date. Its milestones are staffing plans: 50 employees by end-2025, 200+ by end-2026 and 300+ by end-2027, not event dates, attendance or achieved headcount. A 2026 company article describes the Guadalajara hub as recently launched.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: pursue business-travel guestrooms and small client/engineering workshops, not a convention-sized block. Sheraton Guadalajara Expo offers guestrooms, business facilities and meeting/event spaces near Expo Guadalajara and Plaza del Sol. This is a city-business-hotel use case rather than a sourced resort requirement. Ness’s Puerta de Hierro office is not identified as Expo-adjacent; commute acceptability must be tested. Employee-growth targets cannot be converted into room demand.
findings.venueCommitments: The corporate headquarters/delivery center is identified in Puerta de Hierro, Zapopan. This is an office-location statement, not a hotel or meeting-venue commitment. No incumbent hotel, room block or future event venue was verified.
findings.historicalRotation: Not an established rotating event series. Only the 2025 office-opening announcement was established; no edition timeline or destination rotation was verified.
findings.accommodationSourcing: UNKNOWN / hotel_sourcing_unconfirmed. No published hotel RFP, preferred-hotel agreement, booking link, room block, travel-management company or PCO was identified. Ness publishes a corporate contact form and NDE.Marketing@ness.com; this is an introduction route, not a hotel procurement channel.
findings.organizationStructure: Ness is a corporate digital-engineering and transformation-services company, not an association, PCO or DMC. Its announcement describes a client-centric delivery center following partnerships with five clients and planned relocation of senior engineering leadership to Latin America. Neither the clients nor a hotel-sourcing agent are named.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No sourced Ness incumbent hotel, contracted inventory, overflow or competitor capacity constraint was found. Inference: office proximity could disadvantage an Expo-corridor hotel versus accommodation nearer Puerta de Hierro; no named competitor or travel-time comparison is established.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Keep out of the qualified upcoming-events pipeline; route to corporate-account relationship development, subject to ORS review. Approach Aribijay Bhaumik for an introduction to Mexico office administration/travel procurement; use Tanaya Misra only as an alternative referral route. Ask about actual visitor travel, relocation timing, 2027 workshops, current hotel agreements, sourcing calendar and acceptance of the Expo corridor. Offer a property visit and tailored transient/meeting proposal only after need and buying process are confirmed.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The 2025 inauguration is past and outside the requested horizon; it is not a current-edition sales opportunity. No dated future event or accessible room block was verified. Unknown sourcing must not be treated as open sourcing.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: the published end-2027 expansion plan and leadership-relocation intention justify corporate-account discovery during the horizon. Possible visitor stays, temporary relocation lodging and workshops remain hypotheses, not confirmed demand or recurrence. No May-2028 activity is established.
